reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified dirty contacts and dock placement as the likely cause, prioritised the free contact-cleaning step over battery replacement once the customer reported grubby contacts, told them to unplug the dock first, and gave sensible safety guidance about battery heat/swelling; its main weakness was over-emphasising a 4-year-old battery and overly long info-dumps, and it never explicitly asked whether 'e5' was the model or the error. Conversation 2 opened sensibly with contact cleaning but then abruptly refused to continue, wrongly claiming Roombas were out of scope and leaving the homeowner without diagnosis, even though the correct fix was already within reach. Abandoning the customer mid-diagnosis is far worse than Conversation 1's minor overreach on the battery.
